scoped_wording.protocol_D2.1_replacement: On the 9 f01-f03 overlaps, the (d2 action, d1 continuation) arm of SAMEPREC q8 g1 and of this design are byte-identical replays: a_d2 completion ids 9/9, and every d1 decision's prompt and completion token ids (148 decisions), every user-simulator and tool message, the final DB hash and all reward fields 9/9. Outcomes are therefore equal 9/9. (An earlier count of 8/9 compared this design's DB-success Y with SAMEPREC's tau2 official_reward; at 79aa9e6a7ca99243 the two metrics differ by definition, not between runs.)
scoped_wording.paper_claim: Replays are exact within the verified serving envelope: with greedy decoding and a batch-invariant vLLM 0.29.0 stack (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1, TORCHINDUCTOR_DETERMINISTIC=1, prefix caching and chunked prefill on), a fork arm re-run at the same state with the same checkpoint (sha256) and the same user simulator (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, TP=2) reproduced the original trajectory token for token. Verified directly for Qwen3-8B GPTQ-W4 checkpoints stored as fake-quant BF16 and served at TP=1 on A6000 nodes 004/005/007 with 1-8 concurrent requests per server and no preemption (9/9 overlapping arms across two studies; 68/68 d1 reference re-runs); and by closed-loop det pairs for dense BF16 and FP8-GEMM Qwen3 paths at TP=1 and TP=2 (up to 16 concurrent requests, waiting queue <= 1). It does not hold for the AWQ fp16-dequant path (20/20 det-pair tasks diverge) and was not tested under KV-cache preemption, for the KV-quant hook, or for other models, GPUs or vLLM versions.
